verses.original: הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֥ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה בִּשְׁלֹ֨חַ אֵלָ֜יו הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ אֶת־ פַּשְׁחוּר֙ בֶּן־ מַלְכִּיָּ֔ה וְאֶת־ צְפַנְיָ֧ה בֶן־ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- hā·yāh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū mê·’êṯ Yah·weh biš·lō·aḥ ’ê·lāw ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ’eṯ- paš·ḥūr ben- mal·kî·yāh wə·’eṯ- ṣə·p̄an·yāh ḇen- ma·‘ă·śê·yāh hak·kō·hên lê·mōr
verses.literal: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah They said
verses.literalPt: A PALAVRA que veio a Jeremias da parte do SENHOR, quando o rei Zedequias lhe enviou a Pasur, filho de Malquias, e a Sofonias, filho de Maaséia, o sacerdote, dizendo:

verses.original: דְּרָשׁ־ נָ֤א בַעֲדֵ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל נִלְחָ֣ם עָלֵ֑ינוּ אוּלַי֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אוֹתָ֙נוּ֙ כְּכָל־ נִפְלְאֹתָ֔יו וְיַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵעָלֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: də·rāš- nā ḇa·‘ă·ḏê·nū ’eṯ- Yah·weh kî nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel nil·ḥām ‘ā·lê·nū ’ū·lay ya·‘ă·śeh Yah·weh ’ō·w·ṯā·nū kə·ḵāl- nip̄·lə·’ō·ṯāw wə·ya·‘ă·leh mê·‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: Please inquire of the LORD on our behalf since Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is waging war against us Perhaps the LORD will perform for us something like all His past wonders so that Nebuchadnezzar will withdraw from us
verses.literalPt: Pergunta agora por nós ao SENHOR, por que Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, guerreia contra nós; bem pode ser que o SENHOR trate conosco segundo todas as suas maravilhas, e o faça retirar-se de nós.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְרֻ֖ן אֶל־ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.literal: But Jeremiah answered You are to tell . . . Zedekiah that
verses.literalPt: Então Jeremias lhes disse: Assim direis a Zedequias:

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְנִ֣י מֵסֵב֮ אֶת־ כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָה֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיֶדְכֶם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם נִלְחָמִ֣ים בָּ֗ם אֶת־ מֶ֤לֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ וְאֶת־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים הַצָּרִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם מִח֖וּץ לַֽחוֹמָ֑ה וְאָסַפְתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם אֶל־ תּ֖וֹךְ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hin·nî mê·sêḇ ’eṯ- kə·lê ham·mil·ḥā·māh ’ă·šer bə·yeḏ·ḵem ’ă·šer ’at·tem nil·ḥā·mîm bām ’eṯ- me·leḵ bā·ḇel wə·’eṯ- hak·kaś·dîm haṣ·ṣā·rîm ‘ă·lê·ḵem mi·ḥūṣ la·ḥō·w·māh wə·’ā·sap̄·tî ’ō·w·ṯām ’el- tō·wḵ hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: this is what the LORD the God of Israel . . . says I will turn against you the weapons of war in your hands with which you are fighting the king of Babylon . . . and the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the wall and I will assemble their forces in the center of this city
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Eis que virarei contra vós as armas de guerra, que estão nas vossas mãos, com que vós pelejais contra o rei de Babilônia, e contra os caldeus, que vos têm cercado de fora dos muros, e ajuntá-los-ei no meio desta cidade.

verses.original: וְנִלְחַמְתִּ֤י אֲנִי֙ אִתְּכֶ֔ם בְּיָ֥ד נְטוּיָ֖ה וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ חֲזָקָ֑ה וּבְאַ֥ף וּבְחֵמָ֖ה וּבְקֶ֥צֶף גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nil·ḥam·tî ’ă·nî ’it·tə·ḵem bə·yāḏ nə·ṭū·yāh ū·ḇiz·rō·w·a‘ ḥă·zā·qāh ū·ḇə·’ap̄ ū·ḇə·ḥê·māh ū·ḇə·qe·ṣep̄ gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm with anger fury and great wrath
verses.literalPt: E eu pelejarei contra vós com mão estendida e com braço forte, e com ira, e com indignação e com grande furor.

verses.original: וְהִכֵּיתִ֗י אֶת־ יֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְאֶת־ הָאָדָ֖ם וְאֶת־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל יָמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hik·kê·ṯî ’eṯ- yō·wō·šə·ḇê hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām wə·’eṯ- hab·bə·hê·māh bə·ḏe·ḇer gā·ḏō·wl yā·mu·ṯū
verses.literal: I will strike down the residents of this city both man and beast They will die in a terrible plague
verses.literalPt: E ferirei os habitantes desta cidade, assim os homens como os animais; de grande pestilência morrerão.

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֣ן נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֡ה אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶת־ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֣ה וְאֶת־ עֲבָדָ֣יו׀ וְאֶת־ הָעָ֡ם וְאֶת־ הַנִּשְׁאָרִים֩ בָּעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את מִן־ הַדֶּ֣בֶר׀ מִן־ הַחֶ֣רֶב וּמִן־ הָרָעָ֗ב בְּיַד֙ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל וּבְיַד֙ אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְיַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְהִכָּ֣ם לְפִי־ חֶ֔רֶב לֹֽא־ יָח֣וּס עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יַחְמֹ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יְרַחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên nə·’um- Yah·weh ’et·tên ’eṯ- ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ām wə·’eṯ- han·niš·’ā·rîm bā·‘îr haz·zōṯ min- had·de·ḇer min- ha·ḥe·reḇ ū·min- hā·rā·‘āḇ bə·yaḏ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ū·ḇə·yaḏ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem ū·ḇə·yaḏ mə·ḇaq·šê nap̄·šām wə·hik·kām lə·p̄î- ḥe·reḇ lō- yā·ḥūs ‘ă·lê·hem wə·lō yaḥ·mōl wə·lō yə·ra·ḥêm
verses.literal: After that . . . declares the LORD I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah his officers and the people in this . . . city who survive the plague . . . and sword . . . and famine to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies . . . who seek their lives He will put them to the sword he will not spare them or show pity or compassion
verses.literalPt: E depois disto, diz o SENHOR, entregarei Zedequias, rei de Judá, e seus servos, e o povo, e os que desta cidade restarem da pestilência, e da espada, e da fome, na mão de Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, e na mão de seus inimigos, e na mão dos que buscam a sua vida; e feri-los-á ao fio da espada; não os poupará, nem se compadecerá, nem terá misericórdia.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ תֹּאמַ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י נֹתֵן֙ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם אֶת־ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַחַיִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַמָּֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- hā·‘ām haz·zeh tō·mar kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî nō·ṯên lip̄·nê·ḵem ’eṯ- de·reḵ ha·ḥay·yîm wə·’eṯ- de·reḵ ham·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: Furthermore, you are to tell . . . this people that this is what the LORD says Behold I set before you the way of life and the way of death
verses.literalPt: E a este povo dirás: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que ponho diante de vós o caminho da vida e o caminho da morte.

verses.original: הַיֹּשֵׁב֙ בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את יָמ֕וּת בַּחֶ֖רֶב וּבָרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר וְהַיּוֹצֵא֩ וְנָפַ֨ל עַל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַצָּרִ֤ים עֲלֵיכֶם֙ יִחְיֶה וְהָֽיְתָה־ לּ֥וֹ נַפְשׁ֖וֹ לְשָׁלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·šêḇ bā·‘îr haz·zōṯ yā·mūṯ ba·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇā·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇad·dā·ḇer wə·hay·yō·w·ṣê wə·nā·p̄al ‘al- hak·kaś·dîm haṣ·ṣā·rîm ‘ă·lê·ḵem yiḥ·yɛh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh- lōw nap̄·šōw lə·šā·lāl
verses.literal: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine and plague but whoever goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans who besiege you will live he will retain his life like a spoil of war
verses.literalPt: O que ficar nesta cidade há de morrer à espada, ou de fome, ou de pestilência; mas o que sair, e se render aos caldeus, que vos têm cercado, viverá, e terá a sua vida por despojo.

verses.original: כִּ֣י שַׂ֣מְתִּי פָ֠נַי בָּעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֧את לְרָעָ֛ה וְלֹ֥א לְטוֹבָ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה בְּיַד־ מֶ֤לֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ תִּנָּתֵ֔ן וּשְׂרָפָ֖הּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî śam·tî p̄ā·nay bā·‘îr haz·zōṯ lə·rā·‘āh wə·lō lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh nə·’um- Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- me·leḵ bā·ḇel tin·nā·ṯên ū·śə·rā·p̄āh bā·’êš
verses.literal: For I have set My face against this city to bring disaster and not good declares the LORD It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon who will destroy it with fire
verses.literalPt: Porque pus o meu rosto contra esta cidade para mal, e não para bem, diz o SENHOR; na mão do rei de Babilônia se entregará, e ele queimá-la-á a fogo.

verses.original: וּלְבֵית֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḇêṯ me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh šim·‘ū də·ḇar- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Moreover, tell the house of the king of Judah to hear the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E à casa do rei de Judá dirás: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR:

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֗ד כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה דִּ֤ינוּ לַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְהַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִיַּ֣ד עוֹשֵׁ֑ק פֶּן־ תֵּצֵ֨א כָאֵ֜שׁ חֲמָתִ֗י וּבָעֲרָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ dā·wiḏ kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh dî·nū lab·bō·qer miš·pāṭ wə·haṣ·ṣî·lū ḡā·zūl mî·yaḏ ‘ō·wō·šêq pen- tê·ṣê ḵā·’êš ḥă·mā·ṯî ū·ḇā·‘ă·rāh wə·’ên mə·ḵab·beh mip·pə·nê rō·a‘ ma·ʿa·lə·lē·hɛm
verses.literal: O house of David this is what the LORD says Administer justice every morning . . . and rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor or My wrath will go forth like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it because of their evil deeds
verses.literalPt: Ó casa de Davi, assim diz o SENHOR: Julgai pela manhã justamente, e livrai o espoliado da mão do opressor; para que não saia o meu furor como fogo, e se acenda, sem que haja quem o apague, por causa da maldade de vossas ações.

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י אֵלַ֜יִךְ יֹשֶׁ֧בֶת הָעֵ֛מֶק צ֥וּר הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ מִֽי־ יֵחַ֣ת עָלֵ֔ינוּ וּמִ֥י יָב֖וֹא בִּמְעוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ’ê·la·yiḵ yō·še·ḇeṯ hā·‘ê·meq ṣūr ham·mî·šōr nə·’um- Yah·weh hā·’ō·mə·rîm mî- yê·ḥaṯ ‘ā·lê·nū ū·mî yā·ḇō·w bim·‘ō·w·nō·w·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: Behold I am against you who dwell above the valley atop the rocky plateau declares the LORD you who say Who can come against us Who can enter our dwellings
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu sou contra ti, ó moradora do vale, ó rocha da campina, diz o SENHOR; contra vós que dizeis: Quem descerá contra nós? Ou quem entrará nas nossas moradas?

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם כִּפְרִ֥י מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְהִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּיַעְרָ֔הּ וְאָכְלָ֖ה כָּל־ סְבִיבֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem kip̄·rî ma·‘al·lê·ḵem nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·hiṣ·ṣat·tî ’êš bə·ya‘·rāh wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh kāl- sə·ḇî·ḇe·hā
verses.literal: I will punish you as your deeds deserve . . . declares the LORD I will kindle a fire in your forest that will consume everything around you
verses.literalPt: Eu vos castigarei segundo o fruto das vossas ações, diz o SENHOR; e acenderei o fogo no seu bosque, que consumirá a tudo o que está em redor dela.
